summary: First full-stack test of Steps of Execution / Browser Agent Arena. Backend pytest suite covers 35 tests across auth, safety, keys, crabs, runs BYOK, free quota, replays, leaderboard, course pages, self-report, challenges, workflow, exports, and billing — all 35 pass. Frontend Playwright pass verified home/hero, signed-out arena replay chips, protected-route redirect to /login, public leaderboard, sign in (pro), crab create, arena adapters, keys save/test/delete for tavily (UI updates 'Saved · ending 6789' -> 'last test: failed' -> 'Not saved'), studio default mission, 8 workflow presets, pricing 'Pro is active', logout, and mobile hamburger menu with nav items. No blocking bugs found. Did not execute a real live run (LLM cost/time) or complete a Stripe payment.

issues: React Router v6 deprecation warnings (v7_startTransition and v7_relativeSplatPath). Non-blocking but noisy in console. Consider opting in to the future flags.

action_items: Optional: enable react-router v7 future flags to silence console warnings.
Optional: consider raising or documenting the login rate limit (10/60s per IP) as tests can trip it easily when running in tight loops.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — migrate to lifespan context manager.
billing.py uses stripe.error.InvalidRequestError / SignatureVerificationError — these are deprecated aliases in recent stripe SDK; prefer stripe.InvalidRequestError to avoid future breakage.

Course attempts are created anonymously by GET /api/courses/{id}/start with no auth or rate-limit — a scraper could inflate the course_attempts collection. Consider a per-IP rate limit and TTL on unclaimed attempts.
keys.KeyBody has min_length=8 but no upper limit sanity check on characters — non-issue but PRoviders like tavily could match a 'tvly-' prefix pattern client-side to catch typos before storing.
test_credentials: <redacted-email> / <redacted-password> (pro admin); <redacted-email> / <redacted-password> (pro); <redacted-email> / <redacted-password> (free). Newly registered users get NO platform fallback.
seed_data_creation: Some TEST_-prefixed users, crabs and challenges were created during tests. TEST_ prefix marks them for future cleanup. Also a Stripe test checkout session was initiated (payment not completed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests: `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_arena_backend.py -v`. The `_login` fixture retries once after backoff on 429 because the login endpoint is IP rate-limited to 10/60s. If you run the whole suite twice back-to-back, add a ~60s sleep between runs or expect one retry. Real /api/runs live runs against obstacle-1 were NOT executed to save LLM credits and time (~40-90s each); they are only smoke-checked via 412/401/402 paths. Champion replays already exist for public /replays endpoint verification.
rca of the issue: No blocking bug. Only two initial pytest failures were: (1) `test_adapters` assertion used old nested `status` shape; adapters return flat {available,message} — fixed the assertion; (2) `test_lockout_after_5_failures` flaked when previous tests exhausted the 10/60s IP-login rate limit — added a 62s backoff retry in `_login`.
